concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates project directories and the logger/resource‑monitor utilities that downstream tasks (e.g., T002, T004) rely on. Running T001 in parallel could cause race conditions where consumers attempt to write to directories that do not yet exist.

Task T012 is marked `[P]` yet it depends on the complete execution of all prior tasks (T001–T011). By definition it cannot be safely run in parallel with any of its producers, making the `[P]` tag inaccurate.
Task T013 is marked `[P]` but it depends on T012, which itself depends on the entire pipeline. Therefore T013 cannot be parallel‑safe; the `[P]` tag should be removed.
